lines: You wake up... and you can *never* die.
First, you test it. You step off the roof, land on your feet, and brush off the dust. Nothing. Not even a scratch.
Then you do everything. Skydiving without a parachute. Eating the spiciest pepper on Earth. Your friend Lyra screams... then laughs.
Years pass. The calendar flips. Lyra's hair turns *grey*. Yours never moves. Not one strand.
But in every crowd, in every old photo... why is one stranger *not aging* either?
Follow and comment... for part two!
